channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, EU, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound prize - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound prize landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 03 Aug 2026 (03 Aug to 09 Aug 2026).

  • RTM Pitch 2026 (IFFR)
    https://iffr.com/en/blog-rtm-pitch
    International Film Festival Rotterdam (IFFR) · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · EUR 25,000 for the winner (EUR 20,000 from the City of Rotterdam, EUR 5,000 from VEVAM Fonds) to realise the film, plus tailored coaching and an IFFR premiere; a runner-up receives a EUR 5,000 development budget co-funded by QISSA. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

    FOMAS Group (in collaboration with Arte Laguna Prize) · deadline Closed 01 Jun 2026 · First prize EUR 7,000; second EUR 4,000; third EUR 3,000 (all taxes included). NOTE: works are entered via the Arte Laguna Prize, which has a registration fee (approx. EUR 97-122). The winning works become FOMAS Group property (rights of economic use, reproduction, communication to the public, exhibition, distribution and digitisation transferred to FOMAS).
